added: Every startup error screen now says where to report the problem: Report a bug opens the project's Bug report form on GitHub, and an email link opens a message to compendium@contra.dance.
fixed: In the import review, a row set to Re-import onto now says when the re-import changes the dance's form and names what that removes, its Barnes reference or Starts improper mark, and the note above Import counts those dances.
A change to a program template that could not be saved now says so, instead of looking saved.

The import review's "You already have this, by …" and "By …" lines, and the authors and interpreters in a sync conflict, now set names stored family name first apart with semicolons ("Sharp, Cecil; Shaw, Pat"), as the rest of the app does.
changed: The Barnes reference is now a plain text field in the dance editor: a word such as "Ladies" in a tune's name is no longer struck through as a discouraged term.
Times the app stamps itself, such as when a draft was saved, when sync last ran or when a version changed, now follow your device's 24-hour clock setting, as program times already did.

In a program template, each slot's Move up, Move down, Edit and Delete buttons now name the slot's position too ("Slot 3, Break: move up"), so two slots with the same label, such as two Breaks, can be told apart with a screen reader.
